request.style: English, deep male voice with gospel choir, piano, organ, drums, bass, cello, solemn and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A name is written in the scroll
Among the sons of Judah
The record keeps the family whole
Though few have heard his name

[Verse]
He is the brother of the wife
Of Hodiah known in Judea
Her sister stands within the life
A thread of ancient lineage

[Chorus]
Father of Keilah the Garmite
And Eshtemoa the Maacathite
His name is bound to holy ground
In the tribal record found

[Verse]
Keilah stands with Akzib near
And Mareshah in the list
Nine towns with their villages appear
In the allotted land of bliss

[Verse]
Eshtemoa with its pastureland
Where shepherds keep their flocks
Part of the inheritance planned
For the sons of Judah

[Chorus]
Father of Keilah the Garmite
And Eshtemoa the Maacathite
His name is bound to holy ground
In the tribal record found

[Outro]
A name preserved in the book
For those who search and look
